evidence_refs: UI client over the integrated ui_v1 contract; rendering/input routing reuse terminal_g1 G1 candidate; no process-lifetime/signal ownership (backend owns PTYs)

read_first: src/workbench/ui/terminal_g1/app.py, input_router.py (G1 VT rendering/input routing to reuse)
required_behavior: Product UI package under src/workbench/ui/ (new module; name yours) that is a ui_v1 client via UiClient: attach with the terminal size, render the three panes (manager OMP, worker OMP, host shell) simultaneously from replay + live display frames using the G1 VT screen (pyte) and curses drawing, stream state pushes.

Show separately and always visible: which pane has focus; the host input owner (user/manager/unknown) and shell control mode; per-pane alive/exited status; automation state; bridge/backend phase; and the time the UI last received backend state ('마지막 확인 시각'). Focus change is NOT an input-owner change.

Keyboard input goes to the focused pane unchanged (original OMP TUI keys, slash commands, composer/approval keys must reach OMP). Workbench commands use a prefix key that does not collide with OMP/shell keys; the prefix pressed twice sends the literal byte. Required commands: switch pane (each of 3), detach, takeover request/confirm and handoff (existing ui_v1 types), help overlay listing keys. Key choices are provisional (UR-UX will review); document them in the help overlay only.

Paste: bracketed paste is forwarded as a ui_v1 `paste` frame whole; backend rejections (paste_too_large, queue_full, input_owner_manager, input_target_unknown, ...) are shown as a visible notice with the reason; never split a paste into partial sends. Korean/multi-line text must round-trip.
Resize: SIGWINCH recomputes the layout and sends per-pane resize with each pane's actual cell size so OMP/shell redraw to fit.

Exit/detach: quitting the UI sends detach and closes the connection; never stops backend/PTYs; restores the outer terminal (curses endwin, raw mode off) on every exit path incl. exceptions and backend close; prints 'detached; backend keeps running' after exit. Backend closing/reject shows a notice and exits non-zero.
Reattach: screen restores from replay (retained tail) without duplicate input; if replay alone leaves a pane garbled, request redraw via resize nudge as the minimal client does.
Entry wiring per root-adjudication-p27-cw06-entry-wiring.json: start/attach launch the product UI; `--plain` keeps the minimal client.
tests: Add fixture/unit tests under tests/ui/ (e.g. fake ui_v1 server over a socketpair/UDS feeding display/state frames; curses rendered into a pseudo-terminal or via a render function that returns lines). Cover: three panes rendered with focus + input-owner separately shown; focus switch sends focus frame and does not change owner; prefix/literal prefix; paste frame whole + rejection notice; resize per-pane sizes; detach restores terminal and never sends shutdown; backend close handling. Run real-entrypoint smoke with a stub OMP (see tests/backend/live_harness.py for the fake OMP/provider pattern) - do NOT use real provider credentials; real-OMP runtime evidence belongs to the independent test_designer.
